description: This file contains unit tests for the MessageCommandResponseAdapter class, testing its ability to convert between internal message representations and adaptable payloads with appropriate headers within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter context.

classes.name: MessageCommandResponseAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for MessageCommandResponseAdapter, testing serialization and deserialization between adaptable payloads and internal message representations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the MessageCommandResponseAdapter instance before each test.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Provides a collection of message types for parameterized tests.

methods.name: sendMessageResponsePlainTextFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of a plain text payload from adaptable to internal message.

methods.name: sendMessageResponseJsonFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of a JSON payload from adaptable to internal message.

methods.name: sendMessageResponseToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of internal message representation to adaptable format.

methods.name: messageCommandResponse
methods.description: Creates an instance of MessageCommandResponse based on type and internal message.

methods.name: buildMessageHeaders
methods.description: Constructs message headers with proper attributes for testing.

methods.name: subject
methods.description: Determines the message subject based on type.

methods.name: isFeatureResponse
methods.description: Checks whether the current test is for a feature response type.
